subject: Why I’m endorsing Rachel Wallace
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Small Town PAC, [smalltownpac
body:
She’s a lifelong Pennsylvanian and public servant running to lower costs, fix health care, and deliver for working families.
#
Peter,
**I’m proud to endorse Rachel Wallace for Congress in Pennsylvania.**
Rachel is a lifelong Pennsylvanian and experienced public servant who knows how the federal government works — and how it doesn’t. Now, she’s running to make it work for the people and communities that Washington too often leaves behind.
[**Can you help her win by splitting a donation between her campaign and Small Town PAC today?**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260719-rw.IOFlyk&amount=5&refcode=em20260719-876&t=2&akid=876%2E34582%2EzRmdEO)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260719-rw.IOFlyk&amount=5&refcode=20260719-876&t=3&akid=876%2E34582%2EzRmdEO)**
Rachel was born and raised in Pottsville, where her family has lived for 10 generations. They’ve been coal miners and farmers, union workers and small business owners, nurses and church leaders.
Public service has always been part of Rachel’s life. She started her career working for her congressman, Tim Holden, and went on to serve at the State Department, in the U.S. Senate, and in the White House.
But when her mom was diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease, Rachel moved home to be closer to her family. That’s the kind of person she is: someone who remembers where she comes from and shows up for the people who are counting on her.
**Now, she’s running for Congress to lower the cost of living, fix our health care system, and keep our promises to veterans and farmers.**
Her opponent voted to take health care away from tens of thousands of people in his district while his own wealth doubled. Pennsylvania’s working families deserve a representative who will fight for them instead.
Rachel knows her community, she knows how to get things done, and she’s ready to bring real leadership back to Congress. But winning this race won’t be easy, and she needs us standing with her.
[**Peter, will you join me in supporting Rachel by splitting $5 between her campaign and Small Town PAC to help send a champion for working families to Congress?**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260719-rw.IOFlyk&amount=5&refcode=em20260719-876&t=4&akid=876%2E34582%2EzRmdEO)

Thank you,
Tim Walz

Together, we're finding and recruiting thoughtful, hardworking people to run for office, and supporting a new generation of leaders who truly reflect and understand their communities.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. | | Dear Fellow Patriot,

On July 19, a committee of 21 foreign governments gavels into session in Busan, South Korea – and somewhere in the days that follow, they’ll decide whether a 400,000-acre stretch of Georgia answers to them.

Not to Georgia. Not to America.

To _them_ – the United Nations.

And don’t kid yourself that it stops at one swamp. Hand the UN 400,000 acres of Georgia and you’ve handed them the precedent – the next piece of America comes easier, and the one after that easier still.

I’m Craig Rucker, President of CFACT – the Committee for a Constructive Tomorrow – and I want to give you a frank update on what the United Nations is actually up to right now.

Last weekend, you and I were lighting fireworks for America’s 250th birthday – a quarter of a millennium since a handful of farmers and shopkeepers told the most powerful empire on earth to take its crown and its tax collectors and pound sand.

**And now, before the smoke clears, the UN’s culture bureaucrats want to plant their flag in the Okefenokee Swamp.**

They don’t call it a flag, of course. They call it a “World Heritage Site” – a designation of “outstanding universal value.” (Translation: it’s not really yours anymore.)

The UN swears it would “only monitor” this swath of American land. (Right – the way a fox “only monitors” the henhouse.) Ask the folks in Charlton, Ware, and Clinch counties in Georgia what “monitor” means.

They’re the ones who’d wake up to find their hunting land, their timber, their own backyards redrawn as a “buffer zone” to “protect” a swamp that’s been doing just fine on its own since before there was a United Nations to mismanage it.

No hunting. No logging. No pulling weeds. No say. That’s the “universal value” on offer.

[**Will you please add your name to CFACT’s Declaration of Independence from the UN to tell President Trump and Interior Secretary Doug Burgum to pull this nomination off the table before the July 19 deadline**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NDJ9AAwAAAAAAdZiPbmgNGu8Hvy9N64BkiDqGg40lKKhadcMbeZM9glWNvWEaDP7lUCBAMIJZSfPPWhwgfCj5V0ey6ie-K0qJAPQeHAzLEbP7CVcdqo)?
[**Add My Name to the Declaration >>**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NDJ9AAwAAAAAAdZiPbmh9yUSpI8u3krgmU7LtHYyh8q2qTsGjJNzNSekEYfIqF-UxhzTV308OqTIzxLoJXeNttb-X8OZvvFTUb_nlMUU-YcPvUZlMt8)
So how did we get here? A midnight gift in January 2025.

The Okefenokee sat on a UN “tentative list” for some 40 years, going nowhere – until the Biden administration, just before clearing out its desks, rammed through the nomination without so much as a phone call to the people who actually live there.

**A parting gift to the UN – from the same crew that spent four years handing out pieces of American sovereignty to anyone who asked.**

And the outfit advising the UN on whether to bless it?

The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) – the global green bureaucracy whose own network brags about cramming climate “education” into the Paris accord that Trump already tore up.

This was never about alligators and peat moss. **It’s about handing a chunk of America to the climate agenda’s permanent government – the one nobody elected and nobody can fire.**

President Trump already walked America out of UNESCO – one of 66 international outfits he’s shown the door to, including the UN’s climate convention itself. Good.

But walking out of UNESCO alone doesn’t stop this.

**The nomination rides a separate track, and the United States is still bound to the “World Heritage Convention.”**

Which means unless Secretary Burgum formally rescinds it, those 21 foreign governments get the final word on American soil – whether we’re members of their little club or not.

One signature stands between the UN and the Okefenokee – Secretary Burgum’s, on an order pulling this nomination off the table. _That’s the whole fight, in a single stroke of a pen_.

This is exactly the fight CFACT was built for.

Our team went to Folkston, Georgia – cameras rolling – and sat down with the county commissioners the UN never bothered to consult, and put their warnings on the record while the national press looked the other way.

**We’re also one of the only conservative outfits holding official NGO observer status at the United Nations – which means when they convene, we have the standing to be in the room and fight them to their faces.**

That’s the difference between a think tank and a DO tank. And because we don’t take one dime of taxpayer money, there isn’t a globalist on this earth who can buy us off or shut us up.

_The good news?_ This fight is winnable, and the momentum is ours.

Three counties have already passed ordinances against it. When the UN’s own advisors held their little meeting down in Folkston, it did not go the way they planned.

America has walked away from UNESCO before – under Reagan, and again under Trump. The pattern is hard to miss: when Americans actually show up, the globalists lose.

So let’s show up.

clean_body: The only thing standing between the UN’s 400,000-acre power grab and American soil is one decision. | | | | | | | | | | | "View in Browser" A Special Message from our Sponsor Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of Free Speech Daily and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily . | |MCPREVIEWTEXT| | | | | | | Dear Fellow Patriot, On July 19, a committee of 21 foreign governments gavels into session in Busan, South Korea – and somewhere in the days that follow, they’ll decide whether a 400,000-acre stretch of Georgia answers to them. Not to Georgia. Not to America. To them – the United Nations. And don’t kid yourself that it stops at one swamp. Hand the UN 400,000 acres of Georgia and you’ve handed them the precedent – the next piece of America comes easier, and the one after that easier still. I’m Craig Rucker, President of CFACT – the Committee for a Constructive Tomorrow – and I want to give you a frank update on what the United Nations is actually up to right now. Last weekend, you and I were lighting fireworks for America’s 250th birthday – a quarter of a millennium since a handful of farmers and shopkeepers told the most powerful empire on earth to take its crown and its tax collectors and pound sand. And now, before the smoke clears, the UN’s culture bureaucrats want to plant their flag in the Okefenokee Swamp. They don’t call it a flag, of course. They call it a “World Heritage Site” – a designation of “outstanding universal value.” (Translation: it’s not really yours anymore.) The UN swears it would “only monitor” this swath of American land. (Right – the way a fox “only monitors” the henhouse.) Ask the folks in Charlton, Ware, and Clinch counties in Georgia what “monitor” means. They’re the ones who’d wake up to find their hunting land, their timber, their own backyards redrawn as a “buffer zone” to “protect” a swamp that’s been doing just fine on its own since before there was a United Nations to mismanage it. No hunting. No logging. No pulling weeds. No say. That’s the “universal value” on offer. ? So how did we get here? A midnight gift in January 2025. The Okefenokee sat on a UN “tentative list” for some 40 years, going nowhere – until the Biden administration, just before clearing out its desks, rammed through the nomination without so much as a phone call to the people who actually live there. A parting gift to the UN – from the same crew that spent four years handing out pieces of American sovereignty to anyone who asked. And the outfit advising the UN on whether to bless it? The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) – the global green bureaucracy whose own network brags about cramming climate “education” into the Paris accord that Trump already tore up. This was never about alligators and peat moss. It’s about handing a chunk of America to the climate agenda’s permanent government – the one nobody elected and nobody can fire. President Trump already walked America out of UNESCO – one of 66 international outfits he’s shown the door to, including the UN’s climate convention itself. Good. But walking out of UNESCO alone doesn’t stop this. The nomination rides a separate track, and the United States is still bound to the “World Heritage Convention.” Which means unless Secretary Burgum formally rescinds it, those 21 foreign governments get the final word on American soil – whether we’re members of their little club or not. One signature stands between the UN and the Okefenokee – Secretary Burgum’s, on an order pulling this nomination off the table. That’s the whole fight, in a single stroke of a pen. This is exactly the fight CFACT was built for. Our team went to Folkston, Georgia – cameras rolling – and sat down with the county commissioners the UN never bothered to consult, and put their warnings on the record while the national press looked the other way. We’re also one of the only conservative outfits holding official NGO observer status at the United Nations – which means when they convene, we have the standing to be in the room and fight them to their faces. That’s the difference between a think tank and a DO tank. And because we don’t take one dime of taxpayer money, there isn’t a globalist on this earth who can buy us off or shut us up. The good news? This fight is winnable, and the momentum is ours. Three counties have already passed ordinances against it. When the UN’s own advisors held their little meeting down in Folkston, it did not go the way they planned. America has walked away from UNESCO before – under Reagan, and again under Trump. The pattern is hard to miss: when Americans actually show up, the globalists lose. So let’s show up. . Two hundred and fifty years ago, we declared our independence from a faraway power that thought it owned us. It’s time to do it again. For American sovereignty, Craig Rucker President P.S. – Twenty-one foreign governments are about to vote on a piece of Georgia, fifteen days after we celebrate 250 years of telling distant powers exactly where to put their opinions about our land. . Cliff sat down with his old friend Chris Lazar on _Hardball_ this week, and about ninety seconds in, the gloves came off. What starts as a question about the party's latest round of intramural bloodletting turns into the most unsparing twenty minutes Cliff has delivered on camera this year--names named, one Senate candidate's resume taken apart line by line, and a piece of reporting about who's actually writing the checks that will make you want to throw something across the room.
But this isn't just a takedown. Cliff reaches back to the 1890s, to a French guillotine, and to a Delaware witch to explain how we've seen this movie before--and who ends up headless when it finishes playing. If you want to know which fights are worth having, which candidates can actually win, and what one former history TA thinks the party must do before November, this one is worth every minute. subject: When fascists come for the news outlets that enabled them
body:

Hi Peter — Mark Jacob here, contributor at COURIER.

Federal agents went to New York Times reporters' homes last week to
deliver subpoenas in their investigation of news coverage that displeased
the Trump regime.

This is bad news for both journalism and democracy. But it's entirely
predictable. News outlets that minimize and normalize Republican
authoritarianism will eventually find it at their doorstep.

I wrote this week about why the news media's appeasement never buys
safety.

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1003&refcode=20260719_MJ&akid=162%2E344797%2EloJHto ]Before you read on, I hope you'll consider supporting COURIER.
Independent journalism matters most when the government is subpoenaing
reporters and the biggest outlets are still deciding whether to fight
back.

Thanks for reading,
Mark Jacob
COURIER Contributor

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1004&refcode=20260719_MJ&akid=162%2E344797%2EloJHto ][IMG]

When fascists come for the news outlets that enabled them
The NY Times and ABC News find that appeasement doesn't work
By Mark Jacob

Federal agents went to New York Times reporters' homes last week to
deliver subpoenas in their investigation of news coverage that displeased
the Trump regime.

This is bad news for both journalism and democracy. But it's entirely
predictable. News outlets that minimize and normalize Republican
authoritarianism will eventually find it at their doorstep.

The NYT has been simultaneously great and terrible in its coverage of
MAGA. Its investigative reporters have often exposed individual abuses,
but its news editors have failed to shape a coherent warning about the
broader threat to our freedom. Too often, they've been clueless or
trivializing.

When Donald Trump called for "termination" of the Constitution, the NYT
put the story on Page 13. When he lied about immigration and the economy
in an address to Congress, the NYT praised his "game show flair." When he
vowed to take back the Panama Canal by force, the NYT called it a desire
"to expand America's footprint." When he showed that his brain was broken
by bizarrely swaying to music at a campaign rally for 39 minutes, it was
merely an "improvisational departure."

During the 2024 presidential campaign, NYT Executive Editor Joe Kahn said
the survival of democracy was not a top priority in the Times' coverage:

It's our job to cover the full range of issues that people have. At the
moment, democracy is one of them. But it's not the top one — immigration
happens to be the top [of polls], and the economy and inflation is the
second.

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1005&refcode=20260719_MJ&akid=162%2E344797%2EloJHto ]DONATE

The NYT seemed to take civil liberties more seriously last week after
receiving subpoenas over its coverage of problems with Qatar's "gift" of a
new Air Force One to Trump. The regime's investigation is "a brazen act"
that "should shock the conscience of any American," the NYT said.

Of course, the NYT isn't the only mainstream outlet that once thought it
could ride out the fascist movement without getting confrontational with
the fascists. Some journalists at legacy news organizations act as if they
live in a very safe space. They're part of the power structure. They have
lawyers and researchers and expense accounts and multiple layers of
editors to keep them out of trouble. Nothing bad could happen to them,
right?

ABC News may have thought it was protecting itself by settling a Trump
lawsuit for $15 million over host George Stephanopoulos' comments that
Trump had been "found liable for rape" in the E. Jean Carroll case.
Technically, under New York law, it was sexual abuse, not rape, even
though a judge in the case said it would be considered rape in "common
modern parlance." ABC had a good chance of winning the lawsuit because
Trump is a public figure and would have had to prove Stephanopoulos
knowingly made a false statement.

Instead, ABC surrendered, which encouraged Trump to sue other media
outlets. Stephanopoulos signed a new contract and the network moved on.

But for tyrants, there's never enough acquiescence.

ABC's Jimmy Kimmel often mocks Trump on his late-night show, and Trump's
hatchet man at the Federal Communications Commission, Brendan Carr, went
after Kimmel last September. Carr's FCC can't shut down networks, but it
does have the power to launch investigations and pull the licenses of
network-owned local affiliate stations.

Seizing on Kimmel's comments after the assassination of Charlie Kirk, Carr
made his threat:

We can do this the easy way or the hard way. These companies can find
ways to change conduct to take action on Kimmel or, you know, there's
going to be additional work for the FCC ahead.

Nexstar and Sinclair, two major local TV chains, pulled Kimmel's show, and
then ABC suspended him. But the regime's heavy hand caused a major stink,
and inspired calls for a boycott of Disney, ABC's parent company. The bid
to silence Kimmel fell apart, and he went back on the air.

Now Trump and Carr are going after ABC's "The View," whose hosts have long
irritated the regime. Carr's FCC is questioning the show's claim that it
qualifies as a news show exempt from "equal time" rules. As ABC puts it,
"the FCC wants to control who is allowed to appear on the show."

This time, ABC is fighting back, launching an ad campaign urging viewers
to submit comments to the FCC. Tens of thousands have done so.

Better late than never, ABC. It's well past time for other legacy outlets
to defend the 1st Amendment and themselves. But so many of them continue
to betray their duty to a free society.

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1006&refcode=20260719_MJ&akid=162%2E344797%2EloJHto ]DONATE

We'll soon see another demonstration of that subservience with the redo of
the White House Correspondents' Dinner on July 24, featuring Trump. You'll
recall that a gunman interrupted the event in April, and the White House
Correspondents' Association vowed to reschedule the dinner in cooperation
with the nation's most prominent enemy of the free press.

The dinner, which should be abolished, will carry some suspense about what
Trump decides to say. Back in April, some of us anticipated that
journalists would sit there and take it as Trump ripped the "fake news."
But he is unpredictable. To its credit, the NYT does not participate in
the WHCD, though it does cover it. Maybe it will once again praise Trump's
"game show flair."

Trump, who can turn anything into a cheap carny act, is coy.

"I don't know whether or not I will give the same rather nasty statements,
at least as it concerns certain people," he wrote in June. "But we will
soon find out."

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1007&refcode=20260719_MJ&akid=162%2E344797%2EloJHto ]DONATE

name: Veterans for Garrity
subject: A Long-Lost Medal Returns to Westmoreland County
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Garrity for PA * 4075 Linglestown Rd PMB 119 * Harrisburg, PA 17112-1020 * USA
body:
For Stacy Garrity, honoring veterans isn't politics. It's a lifelong mission.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/6kBpsbqSFp4?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
| | | | | | Hi Peter,
Last week, Treasurer Garrity returned a long-lost military medal to the family of a World War II veteran who fought on D-Day.
More than 80 years after Sgt. George Pershing answered his nation’s call, his Army Good Conduct Medal was finally reunited with the family who had spent decades without it.
For most politicians, that would make for a nice photo opportunity.
For Stacy Garrity, it’s something much deeper.
As a retired Army Reserve Colonel who served our nation for 30 years — including three deployments to the Middle East and earning two Bronze Stars and the Legion of Merit — Stacy understands that a military decoration is never “just a medal.”
It represents sacrifice.
Duty.
Honor.
And a promise that America will never forget those who served.
That belief has guided Stacy throughout her time as State Treasurer, where Pennsylvania Treasury has reunited more than 500 lost military decorations with veterans and their families.
And it’s exactly the philosophy she’ll bring to the Governor’s Office.
Stacy believes our responsibility to veterans doesn’t end when they take off the uniform.
It means making Pennsylvania the best state in America for veterans to build their lives after service. That starts with recognizing the skills they earned in uniform by cutting unnecessary licensing barriers, making it easier for employers to hire veterans, expanding access to rural healthcare in rural communities, honoring Gold Star families, helping end veteran homelessness, and protecting the benefits veterans have earned.
These aren’t just policy ideas.
They’re shaped by someone who has lived the Army values of Loyalty, Duty, Respect, Service, Honor, Integrity, and Personal Courage.
Pennsylvania owes our veterans more than our gratitude.
We owe them opportunity.
We owe them respect.
And we owe them leadership from someone who understands their service because she’s lived it herself.
[**You can read the story here.**](https://us.list-manage.com/nwzvnDIYAB9?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
\- Team Garrity

Here's what most people never think about: the rules for your power bill, the grid, and our clean energy future are set by people you've probably never voted for.
They're called State Public Utility Commissioners, and they sit at the crossroads of everything — deciding whether renewable energy and grid policy serve the public, or serve corporate bottom lines. Right now, residents in Georgia and Arizona are fighting to make sure it's the former.
That's exactly what we'll dig into on July 22. I'll be joined by frontline utility commissioners and JanePAC endorsed leaders from those very states — Peter Hubbard, Shelia Edwards, and Casey Clowes — with Kafia Ahmed moderating.
**_It's just 45 minutes, it's online, and it's free to join._**
Democratizing our energy means shifting control back to the people who actually pay the bills. So join us. Let's take that power back — together.

clean_body: The 2026 fight for energy democracy starts here. | It’s Jane Fonda here with a special invitation for you: On Wednesday, July 22, at 6:00 PM ET, I'm teaming up with my dear friend, environmentalist and author Bill McKibben, and a powerhouse lineup of frontline leaders for a virtual conversation about who really controls our energy — and how corporate utilities and Big Tech are driving up costs to keep it that way. | Here's what most people never think about: the rules for your power bill, the grid, and our clean energy future are set by people you've probably never voted for. They're called State Public Utility Commissioners, and they sit at the crossroads of everything — deciding whether renewable energy and grid policy serve the public, or serve corporate bottom lines. Right now, residents in Georgia and Arizona are fighting to make sure it's the former. That's exactly what we'll dig into on July 22. I'll be joined by frontline utility commissioners and JanePAC endorsed leaders from those very states — Peter Hubbard, Shelia Edwards, and Casey Clowes — with Kafia Ahmed moderating. It's just 45 minutes, it's online, and it's free to join. Democratizing our energy means shifting control back to the people who actually pay the bills. So join us. Let's take that power back — together. I hope to see you there, xx Jane | Follow along: | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. Jane Fonda Climate PAC 600 Pennsylvania Ave SE #15180 Washington, DC 20003 United States

President Donald Trump has continued his crusade to radically reform how we vote, targeting the machines we use around the country to cast our ballots and calling for a return to paper ballots that are hand-counted.

name: Bayudan for City Council 2026
subject: Bayudan for City Council 2026
body:
| | | | | |
---
| | | | | |
Dear Friends,I wanted you to be among the first to hear the news—I am excited to announce that I’m running for Daly City Council!This campaign is built on one simple principle: local government should provide **opportunity for all.** Today, families across our city are feeling the squeeze of rising housing, healthcare, and grocery costs. Young families wonder if they can afford to stay, and seniors worry about being priced out. Working people deserve a City Hall focused on making life more affordable while protecting the unique quality of life that makes Daly City so special.As a lifelong resident and the proud son of working-class Filipino immigrants, these challenges are personal. My family has called Daly City home since 1977, when my parents bought our home at the Top of the Hill. I attended our local schools and learned the values of hard work, service, and looking out for your neighbors.My career has been dedicated to serving this community. For the past ten years, I’ve served as Chief of Staff to San Mateo County Supervisor David J. Canepa. As Vice Chair of Daly City's Personnel Board, I’ve also gained firsthand experience in making local government more responsive and accountable. I know how to navigate government, build partnerships, and bring resources home because I’ve spent my career doing exactly that.If elected, I will focus on delivering real results that provides opportunity for all:
* **Affordability:** Improving housing affordability, expanding healthcare access, and helping families keep up with the cost of living.
* **Public Safety & Infrastructure:** Investing in first responders, fixing flooding challenges, repairing potholes, and strengthening transit options.
* **Family Support:** Advocating for a childcare center at Daly City Hall to support working parents and make city services more accessible.
* **Senior Care:** Protecting and expanding programs that help seniors age safely and independently in their homes.

**I’m ready to step into a leadership role myself in every way but I can’t do it without you. As I know from helping to run Supervisor Canepa’s campaigns and you probably do too, campaigns are not cheap.**[**Can you be one of my founding donors?**](https://us.list-manage.com/9dJJVzvoCE_?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)**Nothing is more important to a campaign than early money, as it helps us get off to a fast start and build a winning campaign from the get-go.**
[**Could you donate today in any amount up to $5,900? $1,000, $500, $100 or even $25 will make a huge difference to my campaign at this early stage.**](https://us.list-manage.com/Q_5tNpEXh5Q?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)
Our city has always been defined by hardworking families, diverse neighborhoods, and neighbors who care about one another. Together, we can build a Daly City that is more affordable, safer, better prepared for the future, and continues to be a place where families of every generation can thrive – a Daly City that truly provides opportunity for all.I would be honored to earn your support, your ideas, and your vote.In friendship,
Tony BayudanCandidate for Daly City Council**P.S. Anything you can donate today at**[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tony-bayudan-1**](https://us.list-manage.com/9E0fBFWnEOM?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)**will be so valuable – even if it’s just $5!**

Trump’s illegal war in Iran is back on — and I refuse to let this abuse of power stand.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260719-6486-footer&t=1&akid=6486%2E420207%2E4cDY_7)
The bombs are falling again, Peter.
Trump declared the ceasefire in Iran “over” and resumed military strikes on the Iranian people with no strategy, no plan, and no exit in sight.
We’re staring down yet another endless war.
And Congress has still not voted to authorize any of it.
**Let me be absolutely clear: this war was illegal when Trump started it months ago._It’s still illegal now._**
Congress alone has the power to declare war — and Trump has bypassed that authority entirely, treating our military as his personal weapon to deploy whenever and however he chooses.
That’s not what our Constitution says, and it’s not how our democracy works. We cannot allow this abuse of power to stand.
**The human cost of this war is excruciating.**
Hundreds of Iranian and Lebanese civilians have lost their lives, and thousands more are living under constant threat of bombs.
Families have been torn apart, and communities devastated.
American servicemembers are in harm’s way for a reckless, pointless war of choice.
American taxpayers are footing the bill — _billions of dollars_ , while working families struggle to keep food on the table and gas prices soar.
**This is not in our name. It has _never_ been in our name. **
I will use every tool at our disposal to put an end to this war for good.
[**Will you stand with me today by adding your name to this petition demanding Congress pass a War Powers Resolution and end Trump’s illegal war on Iran?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/sign/em20260719-iran-war-petition-1/?source=em20260719-6486&amount=3&t=2&akid=6486%2E420207%2E4cDY_7)

Thank you for standing with me,
Pramila Jayapal

Peter,
Almost all election experts agree -- the Democrat's path to reclaiming control of the Senate this November runs through Nebraska.
There is exciting news on that front. Incumbent MAGA Senator Pete Ricketts is on the ropes. Dan Osborn, is within striking distance. Recent polls show the race is within the margin of error.
It's going to come down to the wire. A handful of voters could be the difference. And that's why the work of the Nebraska Democratic Party is of concern to Democrats nationwide.
And that's also why we're reaching out to you today to share a concerning update about the race. There is a traitor in our midst and it could cost us the Senate:
---
| [](https://eeuwd7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001gg3SPlr4uvMx87W7nNHEnAZxDGbZ2JVhkoILhzTijKEJSnoQ9O-PBjGpLgJUVHwBXW0YqSpdowENW73gVZwbIYfEk8gK6t8Tl6IyV6SjpBbe4ebgELDOnl-nhAvNA1gUlq0NiLb7C5q8_KzKzJxqT8TE0x-97xYATvx3PNJ3aSr_a8_59tCOJgkKTWMp5S4XYe5A9KhPMtAP8xTUX15pkXMZPZSfCjpi&c=vPGvvwpVBzQrvECSJi41IzDBEMTWuLSVbpvVbswx4E1VLr-kboCEPw==&ch=QnsPk1gDNCrba6CyuKD5ETdIGCyOow_O8Wd-xlWzDbGnY3-g2Rd-Cg==)

A registered Democrat is currently gathering signatures to form a new party. The name of the supposed party, the Nebraska Working People Party, is intentionally named to deceive progressive voters into thinking it's the Nebraska Working Families Party (an ally of ours who is proposing legal action to stop the effort to fool voters).
And if they get enough signatures by July 15th, they can add a U.S. Senate candidate to the ballot this November in order to try to split the vote and hand Ricketts the election.
It's a clear attempt to sow chaos and confusion, to put a spoiler candidate on the ballot to undermine our chances to retake the Senate. And it's coming from a supposed member of our very own party and Republican dark money.
The disgruntled person "leading" this effort just ran for state house and lost badly. When she tried to pay the fee to appear on the ballot as a Dem, her check bounced, and she ran a write-in campaign. When she lost receiving only 300 votes, she endorsed the GOP candidate even though the Dem candidate was the top vote getter giving us a shot to flip that seat.
Now, the candidate who couldn't even raise enough money to appear on the ballot earlier this year, is leading a well funded, heavily organized, statewide effort to gather enough signatures to put a spoiler candidate on the ballot? Sure.......
While the funding won't be publicly revealed until the next filing, it's obvious this is no grassroots effort. There is no doubt this is the work of shadowy MAGA operatives, using a turncoat democrat as the poster child, and dirty tricks to do whatever they can to make sure Dan Osborn doesn't win.
That's why we're writing to you today. If they succeed in getting a spoiler candidate on the ballot, it's going to take a herculean effort by Nebraska Democrats to inform voters about the trap MAGA operatives are setting to deceive voters.
We need Democrats everywhere to help us prepare for that very real possibility.
[Nebraska is ground zero and the Democrat's chance to retake the Senate hangs in the balance. ](https://eeuwd7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001gg3SPlr4uvMx87W7nNHEnAZxDGbZ2JVhkoILhzTijKEJSnoQ9O-PBoqFwGuTPhDGvcTZ8jWOTFdxx7Oc-C7WgH0HKod0VnIdTCILS9G_cla2wFvMp539pXbF5lJ40fS8&c=vPGvvwpVBzQrvECSJi41IzDBEMTWuLSVbpvVbswx4E1VLr-kboCEPw==&ch=QnsPk1gDNCrba6CyuKD5ETdIGCyOow_O8Wd-xlWzDbGnY3-g2Rd-Cg==)[We need your immediate support to fight back. name: Mark Kelly
subject: This wasn’t the plan:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
Team, when Gabby and I first agreed that I would run for Senate back in 2019, we knew things would change. We know more than most how public service can change your life.
But I’ve got to tell you, I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
I know that service comes with risk, sure. But I didn’t set out to be threatened with a court-martial by the Secretary of Defense, or to have the President of the United States calling for my execution.
Look, I don’t want you to worry about me. I’ve been through a lot in my life, and things like this don’t intimidate me all that much.
I do worry that Trump might succeed at intimidating others, though. Like people just beginning to get involved, or thinking about joining a peaceful demonstration, or speaking out at a town hall. I worry Trump and his cronies are trying to scare people out of resisting him.
But then I see millions of people meeting this moment with the courage and resolve it demands of them. People like my friend Chris Pappas. It makes me hopeful, sure. But more than that, it makes me incredibly proud.
We’re ready to fight like hell to save our democracy. If you’re with me, please:

name: DNC.org
subject: “What does the DNC actually do?”
body:
---
Derek, today we’re going to ask you to [**make a contribution to the DNC to support our work**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-july-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260719_8100_fr&refcode2=8100_22930333_tY8cZH&akid=8100%2E22930333%2EtY8cZH) — but first, we’re going to answer a question that we hear a lot: _“What does the DNC actually**do**?”_ It’s a fair question! The answer is that we do a lot, but most of it is not what you would expect. For starters, here’s what we _don’t_ do:
* **We don’t recruit candidates to run for office.** That work is best left up to our sister committees, the DSCC and DCCC.
* **We don’t take sides in Democratic primaries.** Voters pick the Democratic nominee in each race, then we fight like hell to elect them.
* **We don’t dictate messaging for ads.** Campaign strategies are best left up to each Democratic candidate; they know best which messages will persuade voters in their districts.
* **We don’t control or direct Democrats in Congress.** We coordinate with these Democrats when it comes to campaigning, but the folks in office do the governing.

**So what _do_ we do?** Our number one priority is building and maintaining infrastructure to elect Democrats running for office, whether they’re running for school board or for President of the United States. And **that might sound unsexy, but it’s critically important.** Here’s what that work looks like:
* **We fight to protect free and fair elections.** Both in court and on the ground, our legal and voter protection teams fight every day to make sure that every eligible voter can register, vote, and have their ballot counted. We fight against unlawful barriers, voter intimidation, and voter roll purges, and to strengthen long-term voting access through legislative advocacy.
* **We provide critical technology and data infrastructure to 10,000 Democratic campaigns.** Our tech team processes the national voter file, shares it with the state parties, and equips every Democrat in America with the tech to target and reach voters.
* **We build Democratic power in the states.** We invest over $1 million every month in our state parties and have launched programs like _When We Count_ to reach and register new Democratic voters, particularly young folks who are the future of our democracy.
* **We are the administrative backbone of the presidential nominating process.** From setting the order of state primary elections and caucuses to planning the Democratic convention in presidential years, the DNC is already hard at work planning for 2028.

**Derek, our support helps fuel all of this work. Over 99.7% of the DNC’s donations come from grassroots supporters just like you.** That's why we have to ask: [**Will you chip in $7 to the DNC today? We know $7 might not feel like enough to power all of this critical work, but when thousands of grassroots donors give what they can, we can accomplish incredible things.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-july-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260719_8100_fr&refcode2=8100_22930333_tY8cZH&akid=8100%2E22930333%2EtY8cZH) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $7](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-july-2026-gfr?express_lane=true&amount=7&refcode=em_20260719_8100_fr&refcode2=8100_22930333_tY8cZH&akid=8100%2E22930333%2EtY8cZH)**

| **District Round-up 07.19.26**

Dear Neighbor, Thank you for reading my District Round-up. As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you where I’ve been and what issues I’ve tackled in the past week. Criss-crossing the counties of Adams, Franklin, Fulton, Bedford, Cambria, Blair, Huntingdon, Mifflin, Juniata, Perry, Cumberland, and Somerset gives me great opportunities to meet with voters, hear what is on your hearts and minds, and the chance to voice my fight for Everyday Americans. | **An Anonymous Postcarder Nails the Truth** **About Joyce’s Lack of Support for Farmers**

| |
---
**Postcard text:**
**What has Dr. Moneybags done for the farmers of his district? Raised the cost of fuel and fertilizers so they can’t afford to keep their farms! Time for him to go!**
---
Dear Anonymous Postcarder,
---
You’re right!
---
“Like so many Trump promises, the help never arrived. The suicide rate in rural communities is now 3.5 times the national average and climbing.
---
Farmers buckle under the financial strain of crippling agricultural tariffs, rising input costs and a president who didn’t bother to mention them once in his most recent State of the Union address.”
---
Even the $12 billion Bridge Payments paid out in February weren’t enough to overcome the harm that Trump has done through the endless war in Iran that jacked up fertilizer and fuel costs.
---
And persecuting our agricultural work force just means that unpicked food simply rots in the fields.
---
Of course, our own US Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, completely supports Trump’s awful agenda of cruelty and incompetence.
---
He just does it very quietly with his votes in Congress like for the One Big Beautiful Bill Act that ended COVID era subsidies for Pennie, a healthcare that many farmers used until the premiums skyrocketed.
---
But it doesn’t have to be this way.
---
You can elect me, Beth Farnham, to replace Joyce and make policies that actually benefit the people who feed America.
---
Together, we [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=3d7debce49801ec3786c23ba1c60ac9b3eef4d58582a07a821dbb8806302ffba&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8267&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=27abfc084b2d67adee090d2345eb269f&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=ce6017e60f652288ea65b2ffc89303fe) !
---
Sincerely,
---
Beth

| **Proud to Stand in Solidarity With Little Fox Books and Friends**
---
| |
---
Photo credit: Sue Oberman
---
“Do you believe in Equality?” I asked the man draped in what can only be described as a red plastic tablecloth pinned with a fake gold lion.
---
“No,” he said.
---
Of course he didn’t. As I found out later, his red drape and tacky pin are emblems of a lunatic religious society that believes women only belong trapped in domesticity – The American Society for the Defense of Tradition, Family, and Property, usually referred to as TFP.
---
He and his group were there to protest the Drag storytime at Little Fox Books which is a fabulous queer-owned bookstore in Hanover. I stood there in solidarity with every counter protestor in front of the bookstore. I even crossed the street to stand with Pastor Kenneth Peterkin who stepped out of the Emmanuel United Church of Christ because, like me, he is guided by his faith to “love our neighbors as ourselves”.
---
Even the crowd I was with chanted, “Ho, Ho, Hey, Hey, Jesus loves us anyway,” but the meaning was completely lost on those who have decided there is only one way to be a family – their way.
---
I am proud to have stood with everyone at Little Fox Books and UCC. Why? Because I believe in our agency over our own bodies and the freedom to create the families we choose.
---
It is not for those TFP men, or any legislator, or any family, or any church, or any workplace, or any neighbors, or ANYONE to tell us how to make a family. It is only up to the consenting adults in the relationship to decide for themselves.
---
Of course, the Trump administration is hell-bent on tearing down the separation of Church and State which is why TFP and similar groups feel empowered.
---
“A new report by a Trump administration commission suggests replacing the idea of separating church and state with the idea of building bridges between them. The assertion — challenging a longstanding concept in American law — comes amid a raft of recommendations in a draft report of the Religious Liberty Commission, released Friday afternoon.”
---
Meanwhile, my opponent, our own US Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, very much aligns with TFP and voted against the Women’s Health Protection Act of 2022 while he celebrated the overturning of Roe vs. Wade.
---
But I know better than any one of those men in suits.
---
As a child of heteronormative parents who divorced multiple times, I know the sheer harm that purity culture does to children especially.
---
So please keep reading to the children, Drag Queens.
---
Please, everyone who is comfortable doing so, tell your TRUTH.
---
And please elect me, Beth Farnham, to US Congress on November 3rd so we can get back to the separation of Church and State.
---

| **Social Security Woes**
---
| |
---
When will Social Security become insolvent?
---
Sources say, “roughly six years from now.”
---
I remember in my late twenties I used to receive one paper a year detailing how much social security I would receive when I became of age. As I continued to age and work, I liked seeing that number increase over time.
---
But that paper hasn’t come for years.
---
Why not?
---
Because Social Security’s retirement trust fund is projected to face a shortfall in 2032, despite the Cost of Living Adjustment next year.
---
“Social Security’s looming funding shortfall is mainly the result of lower projected birth rates, REDUCED IMMIGRATION and reduced trust fund revenue due to the costs of Republicans’ massive tax and spending bill that President Donald Trump signed into law last summer, according to the Board of Trustees’ report.”
---
That’s right, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act that our own US Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, voted for in order to give billionaires massive tax cuts, is in part to blame.
---
Of course, even with the impending insolvency of Social Security, Joyce and his ultra-wealthy cronies will be just fine.
---
So you don’t have to waste a thought on his future because he’s definitely not thinking about yours.
---
And, in the future, the immigrant-haters can pat themselves on their bony backs, rested in the knowledge that they starved in their sunset years because they didn’t rely on contributions of the foreign-born.
---
OR PERHAPS,
---
the xenophobes out there could:
---
dial back their hatred,
---
recognize that we are all of the human race,
---
realize that American society integrates many peoples,
---
and accept the contributions of those who come from far away to reach their piece of the American Dream too,
---
so that older Americans can live out their last years with a little dignity.
---
Please vote for me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd because I have your stability at heart, no matter your age, and I advocate clear paths to citizenship for immigrants, instead of persecuting them.
---

| PPeter,

This weekend marks the anniversary of the Seneca Falls Convention, where courageous women gathered to demand something that should have never been up for debate: equal rights.

They were told to wait their turn. They were told they were asking for too much. And they were told change wasn't possible.

They proved everyone wrong.

More than 175 years later, we're still fighting to make good on the promise of equality.

We've seen reproductive freedom stripped away. We've watched politicians attack access to health care and undermine the rights women have spent generations fighting to secure.

Progress has never been inevitable. Every generation has had to fight to protect it.

That's why I'm running for Congress.

I'm running because every family deserves affordable health care. Because every woman should be trusted to make her own decisions. Because New Hampshire deserves a representative who will fight for opportunity, fairness, and the freedoms that make our state so special.

The women at Seneca Falls didn't stop because the fight was hard. Neither can we.

clean_body: | = | PPeter, This weekend marks the anniversary of the Seneca Falls Convention, where courageous women gathered to demand something that should have never been up for debate: equal rights. They were told to wait their turn. They were told they were asking for too much. And they were told change wasn't possible. They proved everyone wrong. More than 175 years later, we're still fighting to make good on the promise of equality. We've seen reproductive freedom stripped away. We've watched politicians attack access to health care and undermine the rights women have spent generations fighting to secure. Progress has never been inevitable. Every generation has had to fight to protect it. That's why I'm running for Congress. I'm running because every family deserves affordable health care. Because every woman should be trusted to make her own decisions. Because New Hampshire deserves a representative who will fight for opportunity, fairness, and the freedoms that make our state so special. The women at Seneca Falls didn't stop because the fight was hard. Neither can we. = | | | = | = | = | = | = The next chapter of this story is ours to write. Thank you for being part of it. Secretary of State Marco Rubio gathered diplomats from over 60 countries this past week to host a summit about the threat posed by Antifa and far-left groups to international security.
"The Ministerial on the Resurgence of Political Terrorism" was the first such event that focused on these radical groups by the Trump administration, which laid out the foundation to work collaboratively on tackling the persistent problem.
Rubio told diplomats the Trump administration will be utilizing every tool available to take down cells within the United States and beyond.
"These are not distinct and isolated cells, they are interconnected networks. They do not recognize our borders. They do not believe in the nation-state itself," Rubio said.
"Through intelligence and information sharing, through coordinated law enforcement strategy, through financial targeting and disruption, we will dismantle these networks brick by brick. It is time for the people of the civilized world to defend ourselves," Rubio continued.
## _Watch:_
[](https://substack.com/redirect/e819bc8a-eb06-4056-84e1-ebdb010a4c14?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I believe the most important part of Rubio's speech was when he said the following: "Under President Trump, for the first time, the United States is building the infrastructure, the partnerships, and the strategy to defeat the scourge of far-left terror."
Ever since the horrific assassination of Charlie Kirk, Republicans have been asking President Trump why there has not been a massive crackdown on Antifa and its supporters.
Rubio acknowledging the federal government has had to start from scratch in mapping out Antifa's decentralized network is something that most people don't understand in how the movement operates.

Their infamous black bloc uniform is not just an attempt to intimidate and obscure their identity, it is also to make it hard to attribute a criminal act to an individual if there happens to be video or photo evidence of the act. They want the "revolution to be televised," but on their terms.
The second thing is Antifa's individual cell structure has been Democrats' biggest talking point in denying the movement even exists.
"There is no 'official' Antifa group! There is no Antifa leader!" they insist.
They are correct, but just because a group does not have a CEO or a LLC address, does not mean people are not part of a group with a common goal. It does not take much to organize a violent event, especially when it is centered around an anarcho-communist ideology. Not having a dedicated leader, for police to arrest and the group falling apart, is the whole point!
The people who are part of this movement are delusional, but very dedicated. They live and breathe for the opportunity to carry out their violent plans. So they take steps to insulate themselves so they can continue their desire to go against "fascist" Trump.
This is why it has taken nearly a year to just map the network out. That said, there have been successes in grinding down their operations and securing terrorism enhancements in prison sentences.
Much like the immigration crisis, there will not be an overnight fix, but as long as the momentum keeps going, there will be tangible results.

* * *
[](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6zvdjLjeZKIt1tT_uPEbTC36rMTx9_3aQXl0V7RHkScmHV5Hndpg89F4ukNllAqKJTr3T5Ya-_RX_zNKxfQzlYRorahXg7gyc-64l_qgQf-Au8W1gT8PyhVgABTScl3sMVcQh1WCmuJyv2qTOpRB5JqJ2tTtu4O4WijSNGbpHaruAptsI6zJkiVUS_r2jmBv4F0Gz1eeHmsMGuQUhTyqOmLiBvaSePIg5wWymLG1V_lhm5zJAzbTb5AuGn1seHHv4ncczntjsITrOi8gdGgMKcFW-pCXacmMHhJdVFSVhMb9p5qweeWOWE5y4e_bjgZRVdWxpntsUBSVfXjAG9wZ4FdYCwTL1y79MHiauA_eTUCfLKBQC_8QqFZP-thomkJeWDbkBzxp8nXmYncJaCIbLGI/4sg/GFp6n04fRri5bd_r-0jN1g/h1/h001.YbUvPmaGpw-oyI6f2g5m8bsW0_PQVh9SOY6SKDZv6Bk)Patriot, — I crashed my first tractor the summer after 3rd grade.I spent my summers building churches and running cattle.My high school class had 24 kids in it – We didn't even have enough people to field a football team.It’s Congressman Brandon Gill. You could say I first learned what It meant to be a conservative while I was out on the ranch.When you're building fence out on the ranch you need something to keep your mind going - that's when I started listening to the radio.Rush Limbaugh, Mark Levin, Sean Hannity were on full blast as I drove my tractor, operated the backhoe and built fences.Rush Limbaugh’s voice always seemed to have a way of settling the nervous cattle down.**That's when I first started to think that I wanted to be in politics. I didn't quite know how, but _God had his plan for me._** Those early mornings, those long days, that crackly AM radio — it shaped who I am today.It taught me that America is the greatest place on earth. a land of intrinsic beauty and wonder.It taught me that freedom is worth fighting for as something real and precious that you protect with every fiber of your being.It taught me that God and family are the foundation of everything.So at 29 years old, I decided to run for Congress where I became the youngest House Republican.**[I never imagined that just a few years later, I’d be facing a deadline as massive as this one and sending a final message like this one pleading for your help.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6zvdjLjeZKIt1tT_uPEbTC36rMTx9_3aQXl0V7RHkScmHV5Hndpg89F4ukNllAqKJTr3T5Ya-_RX_zNKxfQzlYRorahXg7gyc-64l_qgQf-Au8W1gT8PyhVgABTScl3sMVcQh1WCmuJyv2qTOpRB5JqJ2tTtu4O4WijSNGbpHaruAptsI6zJkiVUS_r2jmBv4F0Gz1eeHmsMGuQUhTyqOmLiBvaSePIg5wWymLG1V_lhm5zJAzbTb5AuGn1seHHv4ncczntjsITrOi8gdGgMKcFW-pCXacmMHhJdVFSVhMb9p5qweeWOWE5y4e_bjgZRVdu-UVRa2HbdkAs7OWAt2EqMKijK0CQ15-aW4S2zIU-YTP_ik_PguVTnu4iOnB_m4y3dkJ2wpPeIy9wCqOZ6Hso/4sg/GFp6n04fRri5bd_r-0jN1g/h2/h001._JTArzY3PPhqghpZOxgZB46761idv3s3d655PClzsoY)** Look, when I first made my decision to go to Washington, I made a promise to myself, to my wife, and to my children.I told them that as long as I live, I will FIGHT to preserve the soul of America. I promised my kids I would fight for their future.Now, more than ever before, the radical left has infected the minds of our next generation with a poisonous hatred for our country.I knew that If I wanted my two children to grow up living in a better American than I did, I had to let my faith in God and my love for my family guide me to fight with everything I had.Democrats are terrified of me because I’ve spent the last year confronting and exposing their insanity for the entire world to see.Right now, they’re mobilizing ahead of the biggest deadline of the year. And as I sit here running through our donor files over and over again, it breaks my heart to tell you this. We’re falling behind and our window is closing FAST.The Left's cash machine is practically printing money, with immense hatred and calls for violence against Trump growing. Meanwhile, our numbers are dead in the water.So If we don’t turn up the heat now, it’s going to be nothing but bad news. Once our deadline hits, that will be all she wrote.**[Believe me, I’m not someone who finds it easy to ask for support. Emailing you like this is the last thing I thought I’d have to do. But the country we love is on the brink of destruction& I will never stop fighting.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6zvdjLjeZKIt1tT_uPEbTC36rMTx9_3aQXl0V7RHkScmHV5Hndpg89F4ukNllAqKJTr3T5Ya-_RX_zNKxfQzlYRorahXg7gyc-64l_qgQf-Au8W1gT8PyhVgABTScl3sMVcQh1WCmuJyv2qTOpRB5JqJ2tTtu4O4WijSNGbpHaruAptsI6zJkiVUS_r2jmBv4F0Gz1eeHmsMGuQUhTyqOmLiBvaSePIg5wWymLG1V_lhm5zJAzbTb5AuGn1seHHv4ncczntjsITrOi8gdGgMKcFW-pCXacmMHhJdVFSVhMb9p5qweeWOWE5y4e_bjgZRVdzQ8LC0a5lxw9t7haAMXjz8zTF8T53NcWBU96cP5enftPQBSL48NR_IYsxlmJJ_2FOESgVf3g-P2Jnfr1071D4/4sg/GFp6n04fRri5bd_r-0jN1g/h3/h001.rPJDOHR8ee2stvf-uqPu6N01lf5vdwjyZHza4pX8ePQ)****[Will you consider chipping in one more time ahead of our critical deadline?](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6zvdjLjeZKIt1tT_uPEbTC36rMTx9_3aQXl0V7RHkScmHV5Hndpg89F4ukNllAqKJTr3T5Ya-_RX_zNKxfQzlYRorahXg7gyc-64l_qgQf-Au8W1gT8PyhVgABTScl3sMVcQh1WCmuJyv2qTOpRB5JqJ2tTtu4O4WijSNGbpHaruAptsI6zJkiVUS_r2jmBv4F0Gz1eeHmsMGuQUhTyqOmLiBvaSePIg5wWymLG1V_lhm5zJAzbTb5AuGn1seHHv4ncczntjsITrOi8gdGgMKcFW-pCXacmMHhJdVFSVhMb9p5qweeWOWE5y4e_bjgZRVcwgd4b8F-IZwcrSP07KU1ASTTfDFVQtE62qnUxcSH5LVGJVtWslbuCE1TpC9RayyyjqvqduCrvg11F_21ZLIqM/4sg/GFp6n04fRri5bd_r-0jN1g/h4/h001.2IcuhYDP6ChwRmjAeuP6PC_yLvsSZtL-lTwbz8gvA5c)** For America.Congressman Brandon Gill

clean_body: It’s Congressman Brandon Gill. | | | | July 19, 2026 | | Sunday, July 19, 2026 | Estimated Read Time: 3 Minutes Just The Truth Your No-BS Newsletter Dear Readers,Today's sponsor is Congressman Brandon Gill, sharing the personal story that shaped his conservative values and asking supporters to help him continue his fight for faith, family, and America's future.Thank you for your consideration of our sponsors. The Just The Truth Team , — I crashed my first tractor the summer after 3rd grade.I spent my summers building churches and running cattle.My high school class had 24 kids in it – We didn't even have enough people to field a football team.It’s Congressman Brandon Gill. You could say I first learned what It meant to be a conservative while I was out on the ranch.When you're building fence out on the ranch you need something to keep your mind going - that's when I started listening to the radio.Rush Limbaugh, Mark Levin, Sean Hannity were on full blast as I drove my tractor, operated the backhoe and built fences.Rush Limbaugh’s voice always seemed to have a way of settling the nervous cattle down.That's when I first started to think that I wanted to be in politics. I didn't quite know how, but God had his plan for me. Those early mornings, those long days, that crackly AM radio — it shaped who I am today.It taught me that America is the greatest place on earth. a land of intrinsic beauty and wonder.It taught me that freedom is worth fighting for as something real and precious that you protect with every fiber of your being.It taught me that God and family are the foundation of everything.So at 29 years old, I decided to run for Congress where I became the youngest House Republican. Look, when I first made my decision to go to Washington, I made a promise to myself, to my wife, and to my children.I told them that as long as I live, I will FIGHT to preserve the soul of America. I promised my kids I would fight for their future.Now, more than ever before, the radical left has infected the minds of our next generation with a poisonous hatred for our country.I knew that If I wanted my two children to grow up living in a better American than I did, I had to let my faith in God and my love for my family guide me to fight with everything I had.Democrats are terrified of me because I’ve spent the last year confronting and exposing their insanity for the entire world to see.Right now, they’re mobilizing ahead of the biggest deadline of the year. And as I sit here running through our donor files over and over again, it breaks my heart to tell you this. We’re falling behind and our window is closing FAST.The Left's cash machine is practically printing money, with immense hatred and calls for violence against Trump growing. Meanwhile, our numbers are dead in the water.So If we don’t turn up the heat now, it’s going to be nothing but bad news. Once our deadline hits, that will be all she wrote. For America.Congressman Brandon Gill (R) TX-26 Paid for by Brandon Gill for Texas PO BOX 827 Arlington, VA 22216 | | | | Update your email preferences or unsubscribe (C) 2026 Just The Truth 228 Park Ave S, #29976, New York, New York 10003, United States |

body:
Make Sure You Vote

| | | | | [|

| | | | | |
🗳️ **Make Sure You Vote** We are in the final stretch of our contested primary election. We have had great momentum and an outpouring of support from both longtime and new supporters. It has been an honor to serve and continue to represent our legislative district 2 since July 2023. Thank you for your confidence in me — **I truly appreciate it!****Primary Election Information — July 21** Arizona’s primary election is approaching on Tuesday, July 21. Polls are open from 6:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. If you plan to vote in person, remember to bring a government‐issued ID so you can receive your ballot.If you live in Maricopa County, you can find your voting location at:🔗 [https://elections.maricopa.gov/voting/where-to-vote.html](https://us.list-manage.com/CjQ19eRdB2l?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)Once you receive your ballot, fill in the oval next to your selections for each race and then head over to the ballot tabulator. You should receive a follow up email or a text message receipt from the time your ballot is printed to the time your votes are counted. 📬 **Early Ballot Drop-Off Guidance** If you still have an early ballot, it is too late to return it by mail, but you can take it over to your nearest polling place. Many active early voting list voters continue to drop off their early ballot on Election Day. Maricopa County allows voters to show ID and feed their ballot directly into the tabulator at a voting center for faster processing. To learn more, visit:🔗 [https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=sc40hPFb3Ms&ra=m](https://us.list-manage.com/7IVFYQtZOtP?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)**🔐 Election Integrity Training Opportunities** The RNC and AZGOP are offering training opportunities ahead of the 2026 mid‐term elections to help ensure elections are safe, secure, transparent, and conducted according to the law. You can sign up to serve as a poll observer or poll worker at:🔗 [www.ProtectTheVote.com](https://us.list-manage.com/2owc5EiZBen?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)**📣 Report an Election Issue** If you witness an issue involving a polling place or early ballot, you can report it to the **Protect the Vote Hotline** :📞 Phone: 970‐489‐7788🔗 Report Online: [http://ptv.report/UreYv](https://us.list-manage.com/HEtAHFRST1S?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)Every report is reviewed by the **Protect the Vote** legal team, which evaluates the information and determines whether action is needed to resolve the issue and ensure every legal vote is counted.
⭐**New Campaign Primary Endorsements****Stand for Health Freedom** is a national, nonpartisan grassroots organization dedicated to advancing issues related to informed consent, medical privacy, parental rights, religious freedom, and free speech. Stand for Health Freedom partners with state‐level organizations and provides resources, research, and calls to action designed to help individuals navigate complex health‐policy debates.Stand for Health Freedom has built a broad network of advocates and collaborated with numerous state partners to support legislation and public engagement around health‐freedom issues. The organization also created Vote for Health Freedom, a nonpartisan initiative aimed at helping voters identify candidates who prioritize medical privacy and individual health rights. Stand for Health Freedom describes its mission as empowering Americans to protect fundamental liberties and ensuring that families have a voice in decisions that affect their health and well‐being.
**Alliance for Education Freedom** is a national nonprofit committed to expanding educational opportunity and reducing unnecessary regulatory barriers for students, families, and education providers. Their work focuses on promoting policies that support flexibility across all learning environments—district, charter, private, micro-school, and home education—so families can choose the educational path that best meets their children’s needs.
**Bolick in the News** _Arizona Republic -_[ Free Speech Memorial](https://us.list-manage.com/WOlwXBpV5U8?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)
**Bolick’s Recent Legislative Videos** This past legislative session with divided government I worked with my constituents to successfully get 13 bills signed into law. Two bills I’m most proud of getting done are SB1416 and SB1668. **SB1416** , now law giving law enforcement clear timelines to act fast, alert the right people, and reach the public the moment a child goes missing.
🔗 [https://x.com/azsenategop/status/2075291321695387774?s=46&t=ve4XQJ0oA2ruD3ye7jMXeQ](https://us.list-manage.com/G4bTnhS6281?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)**SB1668** , which was signed into law giving the parent with final legal decision-making authority clear say over their child’s funeral and burial decisions:
🔗 [https://x.com/azsenategop/status/2077861397267165210?s=46&t=ve4XQJ0oA2ruD3ye7jMXeQ](https://us.list-manage.com/cQEgeE1wOJF?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211) **Yard Sign Request** If you live in LD2 and would like to request a yard sign, please request one [HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/XPdfYwms2Li?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211).If you would like to volunteer for our campaign, please let us know by [emailing me](https://us.list-manage.com/Ka9XEp47_vH?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211). Thank you for your continued support!Best,Shawnna

clean_body: President Trump is not on the ballot this November. And Republicans need to play defense in states like Ohio, Maine, North Carolina, and even Texas. | Peter, In 2016, President Trump became the first Republican to win Michigan and Wisconsin since 1988. In 2024, he took Nevada for the Republican Party for the first time since George Bush in 2004. He created a movement. He proved the DC insiders and political pundits wrong. But here's the bad news : President Trump is not on the ballot this November. And Republicans need to play defense in states like Ohio, Maine, North Carolina, and even Texas. What then? Well, we'll need backup options. As a former Navy SEAL, all I know how to do is win. And with your prayers and support, I'm confident we will win this race and double the SEAL population in the Senate. Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Democracy Docket: With New Order, Trump Tries to Kill Off Vote By Mail [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=071926_2&amount=25]
We're going to keep hammering this home, Team, because the mainstream media continues to ignore this executive order and how it will change our elections forever.
President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. One provision focuses on a goal that for years has been a borderline obsession for MAGA: Cracking down on voting by mail .
For background: After every election in which he's been a candidate or in power, Trump has raged over the use of mail-in ballots in general and ballot deadlines in particular . He's tried to claim fraud for every single ballot counted after Election Day.
So of course, this order directs the Attorney General to “ take all necessary action ” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day.
This order makes it clear that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.
We can win and protect our elections and our fundamental right to vote. Step up with $35 or whatever you can today and help us defend vote by mail across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=071926_2&amount=35]

We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections . Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail.
Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure , mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic.
Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. If the administration moves forward with these proposals, they will effectively disenfranchise older voters, rural voters, and military voters. ”

For the first time in Louisiana's 214 year history, Republicans just took the voter registration lead from Democrats: | | == We won't mince words--this is a significant blow. Democrats have a real chance to flip the U.S. Senate this year, but they need as many viable paths as possible to get there. Louisiana is one of those paths, where Democrat Jamie Davis is taking on Trump backed Julie Letlow this fall. Jamie Davis is running a historic campaign. He is the first black U.S. Senate candidate to make it to the general election in Louisiana in over a century. He swept the Democratic primary with over 80% of the vote just weeks ago. Davis has real momentum and it's raising eyebrows. Legendary Democratic strategist James Carville has said he believes Democrats have a real "fighting chance" to win this race. But after losing the voter registration lead, the math just got even harder for Louisiana Democrats. That's why the Louisiana Democratic Party is taking emergency counter measures. We just launched our No More Silence - Roll to the Polls Tour which will see us visit 14 cities across 7 regions with a goal to register 50,000 new voters, recruit No Party voters, and make sure every voter in Louisiana knows how, when, and where to cast a ballot. | == Our first stops in Shreveport and Monroe this past weekend were roaring successes. name: Wes Moore
subject: My opponent has it backwards
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1637%2E1086043%2EC6Aufu)
Peter, my opponent has it backwards. He wants to make it easier for criminals to carry guns in public but harder to keep guns off our streets.
**That is not a future I'm willing to accept as governor of Maryland.**
_In three years, we've seen historic reductions in violent crime. Homicides are at their lowest level in decades. Baltimore is on track to have its lowest number of murders since 1970._
Dan Cox would reverse all of it. Less safety. Less accountability. More guns in the wrong hands.
And it just got worse. The Supreme Court struck down campaign spending rules for national parties, and Republicans are ready to pour in money to roll back the progress we've made — from bringing jobs to our state to making our communities safer.
**[We can’t let that happen. We need to make sure we’re able to fight back. Can you chip in today to help us protect what we’ve built and keep fighting for every Marylander?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260719-1.Y0UU88&refcode=em-20260719-1&t=2&akid=1637%2E1086043%2EC6Aufu)**

**_We cannot run this race with anything less than our all, Peter._**
Maryland is _not_ a safe blue seat. We could actually lose – and if we do, Dan Cox will turn back the tide on all the progress we’ve made so far, on public safety and every other priority. **[That’s why I’m counting on your support today.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260719-1.Y0UU88&refcode=em-20260719-1&t=22&akid=1637%2E1086043%2EC6Aufu)**
I’m grateful you’re part of this team.

Once again, ICE agents have taken lives on the streets of our communities. And once again, we're being told to move on.
**I won't.**
For too long, ICE has operated with little or no accountability, too much secrecy, and devastating consequences for families across this country.
