ENDORSEMENT ALERT:
As a proud Republican and State Senator representing Virginia's 9th District, I am honored to wholeheartedly endorse my colleague and friend, Congressman John McGuire, for re-election to the United States House of Representatives.
Congressman McGuire has demonstrated unwavering dedication to the people of Virginia's 5th District. Whether through his tireless constituent services, regular visits across our communities, or his steadfast advocacy in Washington, John consistently puts the needs of Virginia families first.
His commitment to rural Virginia, economic opportunity, and strong conservative values makes him an indispensable leader for our district.
John has also been a vital partner in supporting President Donald J. Trump's America First agenda to save our country. As a fellow veteran and proven fighter for our shared principles, he has actively worked to advance key priorities, including his strong support and vote for the SAVE Act to safeguard the integrity of our elections and protect American citizenship.
In these critical times, we need leaders like John McGuire who deliver results for Virginia while standing shoulder-to-shoulder with President Trump.
I urge voters in the 5th District to join me in reelecting Congressman John McGuire, he is the right choice to continue fighting for our values, our communities, and our nation. Sincerely, Senator Tammy Mulchi Virginia State Senate, District 9

One Patriotic Movie, Young Washington
---
|
---
| Tracy and I enjoyed a wonderful date night watching the powerful movie Young Washington.
This patriotic film vividly portrays the rugged frontier life and the immense challenges a young George Washington faced, fighting harsh wilderness conditions, conflicts with the French, and Indian tribes. Those brutal early experiences forged him into the battle-hardened leader America desperately needed during the War of Independence.
Some of my favorite quotes:
"Is it a sin to seek advancement?" "No man who leads a life of ease will be remembered." "Ambition waits for no one." And when a British officer asked why he would risk going back into enemy fire, Washington replied simply: "My men."
Most remarkably, during one of those battles, Washington had two horses shot out from under him and four bullets pass through his coat, yet he emerged completely unharmed. As Washington himself later reflected, it was only by Divine Providence that he survived. We all know God clearly had a greater purpose for him.
A great reminder of the character, courage, and faith that built our nation. Highly recommend watching it with your family! God bless you, and God bless America!

| Join The "We" Team And Help Save America
---
| |
---
There are many ways to serve our great nation.
Here's an old photo of me with some of my Navy SEAL brothers from back in the day. My SEAL class started with 200 men, only 19 of us originals graduated. One SEAL class graduated zero out of 200. That's because the Navy SEALs have high standards and you must be a team player. It's nothing personal, you either meet them or you don't.
The same principle applies in life. The biggest of the many reasons people fail, whether in SEAL (BUD/S) training or anywhere else, is choosing to be on the "me" team instead of the "we" team. Unfortunately, I see far too much of that selfish mindset in politics.
To save our country, we must put aside the "me" and start working hard together as a team.
As a Member of Congress and a proud veteran, I'm grateful to continue my service to our great nation on the House Armed Services Committee, fighting every day to make sure our warfighters have the equipment, training, and support they need to win and come home safely.

I studied the techniques of great authors who broke stories that transformed America. From Stetson Kennedy, who infiltrated the highest echelons of the KKK in the 1940s, to Upton Sinclair, who went undercover in the 1900s working in a meatpacking plant in Chicago. Sinclair's book, The Jungle, resulted in a national uproar over food safety and the creation of what is now the Food and Drug Administration. Every notable author and journalist who came before me used similar tactics to get the story: fearless boots on the ground. And as I've found in my nearly 20 years as a journalist, my job is limited to what I can see and record through public access . . . undercover or not. At the end of each investigation, I'm left wanting more. I can see the threads dangling in front of me, waiting to be pulled, but accessible only to law enforcement and their powers to investigate. **But now, the world has shifted . . .** I testified before the Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee (HSGAC) of the United States Senate regarding "Fraud in America." Following my opening remarks, where I expressed my limits as a journalist, something extraordinary happened. **Committee Chairman Rand Paul invited me to submit requests for subpoenas to his office.** Notably, Senator Paul, as the chairman of HSGAC, is the only member of the Senate with **unilateral authority** to issue subpoenas. From Upton Sinclair to Woodward and Bernstein, the model for action has been: **Journalist publishes -> Institution reacts.** After my testimony before the Senate, that model will be inverted . . . **at least temporarily.** Power shifts. Rules change. **Doors close.** That's why we have to [**move fast**](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=f913f392e7c64bedac53e5b68b53fc96&_e=aFo7eCxaK64s6XBfjPAiIxve7VBugl33UpUokenja5XfIAFySfzjPFLaNBoIhPYHZgLhzHN5zBqVGxXFE_FXWJ4AFRPTPZbgGCPbKvMv9hCoGpBSWxjg6R1hOPORVJ7civNIQ3FDdX6b7NEWTJN7LgTtaRM0F0EMlneVZoKSdQO3_485Q6H94fJHmj5TbMJNDJJYXD2N33Wa3Aa_tG__B5Ttke4FWNbOyFlMIXi7DAE6hQfDccsShyYnYH8k9EwjDMVJXAwJOw0yHMpAYfCyqwe4yLkEVdM8Vp3oWIGDkMj9xELt5yke9icmJw6ViRQ5BakLy1T4vfrSziJqsUhJ7vUTEJAYfDdQaOZYrp09rr8UfC8tTNxtkjeB9rhWeHs9E3r3aKNiC4Cslxvn7jR3I4HGsewXa_Lm7e6je3UxWOtdSAr5ULMJqbfUUcylxQCUQlQu7yuvhVnHjXavgXFx2iK3StYFHOuY-D8i-goR4bDvY9CaKnYC_Z3FoSFBnPsEGa3Pej3_XXHT1NYpvF4cs9LnvGkJX_DJ-cRyWMaIfxik543ncdJ2Q-y6BCc_HyUA3OOD7YSOItECHbsoaCA61jQDWhan1oZlzV-A-Ycyn98%3D), and I need your help more than ever to take advantage of an unprecedented offer. I'm putting together a small team of researchers who can pull those dangling threads left from current and previously closed investigations.
* We can follow the money trails to see who is truly behind the fraudulent ballots.
* We have a shot at unraveling the global web of money that funds illegal immigration.
* We finally have a chance to see the documents behind Pfizer's illegal "Gain of Function" research on COVID-19.

**At the bottom of every rabbit hole is a lock box filled with receipts.** Senator Paul has handed us a golden key. In today's dollars, Capone's criminal enterprise was worth $2 billion. Taxpayers are being defrauded of at least **$250 billion every year** on the federal level alone -- money out of your pocket, counted against your vote. Taxpayers are being defrauded of at least $250 billion every year on the federal level alone -- money out of your pocket, counted against your vote. And at the Senate hearing on Fraud in America, our elected officials admitted that the governmental bodies tasked with stopping fraud for decades are wholly ineffective. That leaves us to do the job. Are you in? We have HUNDREDS of Al Capones to take down who have been ripping all of us off and stealing our national treasure . . . and our votes. Time is short.** Thank you for all that you do. In Truth, James O'Keefe Founder, O'Keefe Media Group P.S. I'm still grasping the impact of the Senate hearing. Most journalists might just smile and say "thank you" if Senator Paul asked them to submit subpoena requests to him. But those journalists have not gone as deep as I have. They haven't risked their lives. Some never leave the comfort of their office. I know what the offer means. I've lived with the frustration of knowing that the true players behind an operation can hide in darkness. With your help, OMG is taking advantage of this immediately -- until the door closes. | | It’s already time to get ready for the next round of this fight. Last month, after a broad public outcry, Georgia GOP lawmakers gave up on a plan to draw new voting maps that would gut Black and brown political power. But they may be getting ready to try again after the November elections. So we’re getting ready to fight back — again. We can win — again — by organizing widespread resistance against this power grab. That will include mobilizing Georgians to make their voices heard. body:
Believe it or not, he didn’t make it to the NBA

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135587287/634716607/-2014140140?refcode=email_071926_photo&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOGNlNWQ1My1jNzgzLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WKWR79GnZkK1-02BgD1VSUPVdmMIfK07BeGzNo9SBG8=) See that short kid in the front, Derek? I know it might be hard to believe, but he didn’t make it to the NBA._Not even close._ In fact, that kid got cut from his college basketball team his freshman year. But not long after, he found a new path. He ran for student government... and won. He added more outdoor lights on campus, blue light security phones, and even improved the shuttle service at night. He saw what committed, commonsense leadership could accomplish. So when he won a Republican-controlled state House district, he got to work — and helped pass some of the toughest ethics laws in Pennsylvania history. As Attorney General, he worked to protect healthcare access for Pennsylvanians, get justice for survivors, and defend our democracy from Donald Trump. And now as Governor? That kid has delivered record funding for our public schools, free breakfasts for our K-12 students, and cut taxes ten times for the folks who need it most. **Okay, okay, I think you get the point: That kid? That’s me. But one thing you should know? I didn’t accomplish any of that on my own.** Each and every time, I had a team of supporters behind me. And Derek, it’s going to take our biggest team yet to take down our far-right opponent and all her Mar-a-Lago donors on November 3rd. # RECORD FUNDRAISING, ENDORSEMENTS, LILY IN THE NEWS
&
ASK ME ANYTHING TOWN HALL

**Record Fundraising**
Highest since NH-02 Republican Representative Charlie Bass in 2014!

I can’t thank enough my _individual_ donors across the country. After raising $230K this past 2nd quarter, we have total raised over $1.1 million with $664K cash on hand. I look forward to winning the NHGOP primary nomination on Sept. 8th so I can have a REMATCH with Congresswoman Maggie Goodlander this November.

**National Endorsements**
I am deeply honored to receive endorsements from _Gun Owners of America_ , _Republican Women’s Caucus Fund_ and _Republican Liberty Caucus_.

_“Lily escaped Communist China in pursuit of the American Dream and has dedicated her life to defending freedom, the Constitution, and the liberties that make America exceptional,”_ said Congresswoman Kat Cammack, Republican Women’s Caucus Fund Chair. _“The RWCF is proud to endorse her.”_

**Lily In the News**
[Mao Survivor Lily Tang Williams Sounds the Alarm on Socialism](https://us.list-manage.com/2h13P1ULBQE?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)
[Lily Tang Williams Warns of China's Growing Influence in America](https://us.list-manage.com/1zb34zIxJ0W?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

**ASK ME ANYTHING TOWN HALL SERIES**
My campaign is rolling out "Ask Me Anything" Town Hall Series, an ongoing series of open, unscripted public forums where every Granite Stater in NH-02 is invited to ask any question, raise any issue, and engage in a candid conversation about the future of New Hampshire and the country.

Unlike carefully managed political events, there will be no pre-screened questions. The events are open to the public and the media. The town halls are intended to restore the New Hampshire tradition of accessible, accountable leadership.

This is the first of my ASK ME ANYTHING TOWN HALL series on July 30th in Windham. For more events, please check out EVENTS on my website: lily4congress.com
If you are in NH-02, would like to request for a town hall at a venue that can seat 50-100 people, please reach out and we would love to hear your suggestions.

**Going Viral **
I made this video last June after Mamdani’s win. It is time to warn Americans again after socialists winning primaries for Congress. [https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1arxP2aP36/](https://us.list-manage.com/ZF5fuEHqZoS?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)
There are plenty of them in Congress, enough already! My lived experience and perspectives are badly needed in U.S. House to counter them.
I will always defend American and NH Live Free or Die values in Congress. Please help me win.

[DONATE](https://us.list-manage.com/4zQMQEmSX2l?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

Michigan’s Democratic Senate nominee. That’ll hopefully be us after August

Democrats tend to get wrong. We're so worried about what Republicans are
going to say about us that we forget that we have a voice too.

MAGA Mike Rogers is a guy who's never met a pharma lobbyist he didn't
love.

Pharma and then swiftly voted to raise prescription drug prices again and
again. He helped write the legislation that led to the opioid epidemic.

**SUMMER 2026 CAMPAIGN MEMO ON TX-GOV** **FROM:** Amy Friedman, Campaign Manager, Gina for Texas
**TO:** Interested Parties Let me tell you exactly where our race stands, and why the next few months are going to determine whether this is the year we take Texas back.

The Texas governor’s race has been in single digits for months, and it still isn’t getting the attention it deserves from national Democrats. The polls tell a consistent story: Abbott is in the weakest position of his career.

**Recent polls confirm this race is closing fast:**
* Texas Public Opinion Research (April 2026): Abbott 48–Gina 43, with Gina winning independents by 13, moderates by 32, and Latino voters by 22
* Somos Votantes (April 2026): Gina leads with Latino voters statewide
* A PPP survey found Gina tied with Abbott 48-48 in TX-23, a district Trump carried by 15 points.
* A three-term incumbent who cannot break 50% in any publicly released poll is an incumbent in trouble.

**Abbott’s war chest is a real threat — and it’s built on corruption**
* Greg Abbott entered 2026 with $105.7 million on hand. Nine figures.
* He didn’t build this by winning over working Texans. His top donors include oil executives, private prison owners, and data center developers — at a time when data centers are threatening to spike Texas utility bills.
* This is what pay-to-play governance looks like. Abbott has handed out $1 billion in no-bid contracts to his donors. He rammed through a $1 billion school voucher scam after receiving the largest campaign contribution in Texas history from an out-of-state billionaire.
* The Greg Abbott Corruption Tax is real — and Texans are paying it every time their utility bill, property tax, or grocery receipt arrives.

**After 12 years in power, Greg Abbott owns Texas’s problems — and they are serious.**
* Texas has the highest uninsured rate in the country (for adults and for children).
* More than one million Texas kids lack health coverage, and it’s getting worse.
* Abbott has refused Medicaid expansion for over a decade, leaving hundreds of thousands of Texans without coverage and billions of federal dollars on the table.
* Property taxes have increased 75% under Abbott. Texans pay the highest property tax burden in the state’s history. Abbott has said for years he’ll fix it. But it keeps getting worse.
* Abbott held public school funding hostage in 2023, refusing to fund classrooms unless the Legislature passed his voucher scam. School districts across the state have had to lay off staff, cut programs, and close schools as a result.
* Texas has had more major power outages than any other state. The grid failed in 2021, killing Texans. Abbott promised it was fixed, but problems persist.

**Gina has built something real — but we need more resources to carry her message forward.**
* Gina is running a people-powered campaign. Her average donation is under $50.
* She is winning key demographics: independents by 13, moderates by 32, Black voters by 57, Latino voters by 22, and voters 18-24 by 49.
* Gina is tied with Abbott in a Trump +15 district. She is cutting into Abbott’s base. It’s a sign she’s genuinely connecting.
* But $106 million is a lot of money. When that money hits the airwaves across the state, we’re going to need real resources to fight back.

**Texas Democrats are positioned to win.**
* All the warning signs are flashing for Republicans – not only are they trailing in polling, but they are losing special elections left and right this year in historically deep red areas of Texas, where Democrats are turning out to flip school board seats, county commissions, and state Senate seats too.
* For the first time in years, Texas Democrats have candidates at the top of the ticket with real momentum in both the governor’s race and the U.S. Senate race:
* Gina is closing the gap in a state that hasn’t elected a Democratic governor for 30 years. Talarico has a small edge in the Senate race. The environment is here. Texas has a very strong Democratic ticket. Now we just need the investment to match it.

**The bottom line.**
* Greg Abbott is scared. He’s told his own donors he’s at real risk of losing seats statewide. His approval is at a career low.
* The coalition Gina is assembling: Latino voters, young voters, independents, moderates, working families across every corner of Texas — is the coalition that will win this race.
* This is Democrats’ best chance in 25 years to take back Texas. The coalition is here, the candidates are out front, working hard to carry their message to every voter. The environment is favorable. What determines whether we win is whether national Democrats decide Texas is worth the investment.
* **We can win this race if we all show up.**
